summary:
Radar for 26 Nov 2026 (Thanksgiving Day, US). The biggest new signal is the second wave of vision-loss coverage. Health Canada issued a semaglutide NAION warning on 25 Nov, picked up by CBC, CTV, the Globe and Mail, the Toronto Star and Yahoo. That follows the FDA's class-wide label warning on 9 Nov. This is a label-change, search-demand moment, and the phrase people type is "Ozempic vision loss". Two more topics are new to our radar and break into mainstream news this week. First, breast density and mammogram callbacks after GLP-1 weight loss (TODAY, Fox, Everyday Health, Medical News Today), which matters most to our women viewers. Second, dizziness when someone already on blood pressure medicine starts a GLP-1 (Medscape's 'check their meds', backed by the Northwestern cohort of 42,000 adults). Both are observational, so both are rated caution and need tight wording.

Foundayo has a randomized result, ATTAIN-OSA (52 weeks, AHI −43.8% without PAP). HCPLive re-covered it on 24 Nov, but it was first presented around 9 Nov, so it misses the 48-hour fast-turn window. It's better used as a chapter or follow-up to the Foundayo What to Expect video than as a new fast-turn.

Thanksgiving felt-symptom Shorts peak today and tomorrow, then the 20:00 slot rotates out (from 11-28). Evergreen demand remains strong for:
- tirzepatide hair loss
- nausea
- the 6-month timeline
- keeping results after stopping (refreshed by Medscape's 25 Nov feature)
- the pen and vial Instructions for Use how-tos

Several items are already made or held in production: Serious Risks, After 6 Months, Vial vs Pen and SURPASS-CVOT. Re-render or fix those; never script them again. Rejected:
- compounded-drug recalls (Greenwich Rx) and price indexes
- counterfeit and gray-market retatrutide stories
- pipeline items backed only by animal or China-only data (Tencent, BrightGene, DA-1726)
- Medicare negotiation, lawsuits and the trial in 6–11-year-olds
- the colectomy case report

Sources: [Healio ATTAIN-OSA](https://www.healio.com/news/cardiology/20261109/oral-glp1-reduces-sleep-apnea-severity-improves-cardiometabolic-risk-factors), [TCTMD](https://www.tctmd.com/news/attain-osa-oral-glp-1-linked-fewer-breathing-interruptions), [Fierce Pharma](https://www.fiercepharma.com/pharma/lilly-heads-fda-phase-3-foundayo-win-sleep-apnea), [Benefits and Pensions Monitor](https://www.benefitsandpensionsmonitor.com/news/industry-news/us-fda-adds-the-glp-1-eye-risk-warning-canada-already-requires/394418), [Global News](https://globalnews.ca/news/12144337/glp1-vision-loss-warning-fda/), [Northwestern](https://news.northwestern.edu/stories/2026/06/glp-1s-tied-to-elevated-risk-of-low-blood-pressure-episodes-such-as-fainting-and-dizziness), [HealthDay](https://www.healthday.com/health-news/weight-loss/taking-glp-1s-while-on-bp-meds-may-up-your-risk-of-dizzy-spells-fainting), [CancerNetwork](https://www.cancernetwork.com/view/the-impact-of-glp-1-mediated-weight-loss-on-mammographic-density-and-radiomic-risk), [Springer case](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s40134-025-00433-2), [Healio SELECT frailty](https://www.healio.com/news/cardiology/20260917/wegovy-benefits-in-select-trial-population-consistent-regardless-of-frailty-level), [PMC sleep study](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC12256015/)

candidates.topic: Ozempic and Wegovy vision-loss warning (NAION): what Health Canada said on 25 Nov, what the FDA's 9 Nov class-wide label change means for semaglutide and tirzepatide, and which eye symptom means get help now
candidates.angle: Calm label-change explainer. NAION in one sentence (sudden, painless vision loss in one eye). How rare 'very rare' is, by label frequency wording. What changed on the label in Canada and the US. Make the drug-specific chapter tirzepatide, since our audience is mostly on it. The one action: sudden vision change means same-day care. Never 'stop your drug'; say 'contact your prescriber'. Fold this into the held Serious Risks re-render as a fresh hook, or make it a separate label-change video titled 'Ozempic (Semaglutide) Vision Loss Warning: How Rare Is It?'. Check for duplication against Serious Risks before scripting.
candidates.why_now: Health Canada's warning on 25 Nov landed in CBC, CTV, the Globe and Mail, the Toronto Star, Yahoo Canada and CBC's The National within 12 hours. Bloomberg ('Now the drugs will have a warning label'), FOX 5 and Ophthalmology Times are running in parallel. It's a second wave on top of the FDA action on 9 Nov. This is a label-change search-demand format, and the 10–195x outlier class in this niche.

evidence.signal: Health Canada issues warning on rare risk of vision loss with semaglutide GLP-1 drugs (25 Nov)
The FDA adds the GLP-1 eye-risk warning Canada already requires. The Wegovy monograph lists NAION as 'very rare' and says to discontinue if it occurs.
Coverage of the FDA's GLP-1 vision-loss warning
Q&A on NAION and the same-day workup (clinician interest)

candidates.topic: Thanksgiving on tirzepatide, the morning after: still full, bloated, nauseous or heartburn after the big meal. Is this normal, and what usually helps?
candidates.angle: Felt-moment Shorts for today and tomorrow, with the relief fact in sentence 1. Slowed stomach emptying explains why the meal 'sits'. GI effects are most common around dose increases and usually ease. Gentle steps: smaller portions, slow down, sip fluids. Severe or persistent belly pain or vomiting means call your prescriber. Link each Short to the Thanksgiving long video.
keywords: zepbound nausea after eating too much
full the next day on mounjaro
candidates.why_now: It's Thanksgiving Day. MedPage Today, NPR, the Boston Herald, FOX 7, 11Alive and WAND all ran GLP-1 Thanksgiving stories in the last 24 hours. Our own proof: full the morning after 495, stuffing 329, stomach pain 274. The slot rotates out on 11-28.

evidence.signal: As GLP-1 use grows, patients and doctors rethink Thanksgiving dinner (26 Nov)
A nutritionist on navigating Thanksgiving on a GLP-1

candidates.topic: Dizzy or lightheaded on tirzepatide when you also take blood pressure medicine: why it can happen as weight and blood pressure fall, and when to call
candidates.angle: Felt symptom plus 'Is this normal?'. Losing weight often lowers blood pressure, which is a real benefit. For people already on BP pills, that can sometimes tip into lightheadedness. In the Northwestern cohort of 42,000 adults, low-BP events rose from 8.7% to 10.2% within 6 months (observational, highest in people over 65 and those with diabetes). Our action line is never 'adjust your pills'. It is: tell your clinician, who may review your BP medicines, and note readings. Add hydration as a supportive habit. Fainting means urgent care.
candidates.why_now: Medscape's 25 Nov feature ('Your patient lost weight on a GLP-1: time to check their meds') refreshes the Northwestern data from June. Pharmacy Times' adverse-effects monitoring piece ran the same day. Searches for this felt symptom are evergreen, and YouTube coverage that pairs dizziness with BP medicine is thin.

evidence.signal: Your patient lost weight on a GLP-1: time to check their meds (25 Nov)
42,000 adults on BP medicines: low-BP events rose from 8.7% to 10.2% within 6 months of starting a GLP-1 (observational)
Taking GLP-1s while on BP meds may raise the risk of dizzy spells

candidates.topic: Foundayo (orforglipron) and sleep apnea: the 52-week ATTAIN-OSA phase 3 trials (AHI −43.8% without PAP, −27.5% with PAP), and how that compares with Zepbound's approved sleep-apnea use
candidates.angle: A drug-name-searched result for an approved pill. Say the result and the population in one sentence: adults with moderate-to-severe OSA and obesity or overweight. State clearly that sleep apnea is not yet an approved use for Foundayo (Lilly plans to file by end of 2026), while tirzepatide is approved for OSA in adults with obesity. Best as a chapter or watch-next follow-up to the Foundayo What to Expect video (ssb7Zcs3KSY). Only one Short, a practical question: 'Can the Foundayo pill help my snoring and sleep apnea?'.
candidates.predicted_peak: 1–3 weeks (spikes again at the FDA filing)
candidates.why_now: HCPLive re-covered ATTAIN-OSA on 24 Nov. A retatrutide sleep-apnea headline ('Forget Zepbound', Motley Fool and Yahoo, 24 Nov) is pushing the sleep apnea plus GLP-1 query. Foundayo search already earns us about 60 min a day.

evidence.signal: Orforglipron reduces sleep apnea severity in ATTAIN-OSA (24 Nov)
Two phase 3 trials: improved AHI, weight, inflammation and blood pressure
17–18 fewer events per hour vs 5 on placebo; hypoxic burden −72% vs placebo
Lilly heads to the FDA for a Foundayo sleep-apnea label

candidates.topic: Mammogram callback after GLP-1 weight loss: why breasts can look denser on the scan when fat is lost, and what to tell the imaging team
candidates.angle: For our women viewers, reassuring and practical. Losing fat raises the share of glandular tissue, so density can read higher. That is a known effect after bariatric surgery too, not a sign of cancer. Callbacks are for extra pictures. The practical step is to tell the imaging centre about recent weight loss and the GLP-1. Keep the separate observational ASCO data (lower breast cancer incidence) as 'linked to', never 'prevents'. Don't overstate the new study until the fact-checker confirms its design and numbers.
candidates.why_now: TODAY (twice), Fox News, Everyday Health, Medical News Today, Medical Daily ('more than 1 in 5 women called back') and healthcare-in-europe covered it on 24–26 Nov. No health creator has an explainer yet. Women are the core of our hair-loss audience.

evidence.signal: GLP-1 weight-loss drugs tied to higher breast density in new study (24 Nov)
After GLP-1 weight loss, more than 1 in 5 women were called back for extra imaging
GLP-1 weight loss and mammographic density (expert context)
A woman who lost 65 lb on tirzepatide showed higher density on screening; a mechanism like that seen after bariatric surgery

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide hair loss: why it's more common in women (label 5.4% vs 0.9%; women 7.1% vs 1.3%), when shedding shows up, and whether it grows back
candidates.angle: A calm 'Is this normal?' Short with the relief fact in the same sentence: this kind of shedding after fast weight loss is usually temporary. Back it with protein and an iron check with a doctor. Never 'stop the drug'. The Hair Loss long video needs a retitle ('Why More in Women?'), not a new video. Keep hair Shorts pointing to it.
keywords: does hair grow back after mounjaro
candidates.why_now: Our best Short ever was hair (1,035). Search demand is steady, and the held S1 11-26 Hair Shedding Short only needs a remix.

evidence.signal: Hair Short at 1,035 views; the topic has appeared in 6 radar snapshots in a row at momentum 80

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound) after 6 months: what to expect, from the label and SURMOUNT-1 through 72 weeks (series part 3)
candidates.angle: A what-to-expect timeline built on the label and SURMOUNT-1. Already held (L1 11-25): fix the 'tears appetite' scene, s13 'placebo plus counseling', the s26 emergency card and the s3 sleep apnea approval, then render. Don't script it again. It links from Months 2–6.
candidates.why_now: Timeline formats are a 10x-plus outlier class. 'Tirzepatide what to expect after 3 months' SEO pages are multiplying (Derby-Diocese spam cluster, 23–24 Nov), which shows search demand.

evidence.signal: Tirzepatide weight loss results: what to expect after 3 months (23 Nov)

candidates.topic: Keeping weight off after stopping tirzepatide: SURMOUNT-4 (+14.0% regain on placebo, still 9.9% below baseline), refreshed by Medscape's 'Keeping weight off during and after GLP-1 treatment'
candidates.angle: Encouraging and honest. Some regain is common after stopping, but much of the loss stays, and habits (protein, strength, sleep) are what we can control. No stopping or switching advice. Use the 25 Nov Medscape piece as the hook for Shorts, and link to the Stopping and Keeping Results videos rather than making a new long video.
keywords: what happens when you stop zepbound
candidates.why_now: Medscape (25 Nov) and Bioengineer's weight regain after incretin cessation (26 Nov) are both new. Stopping is our fastest-growing long video (936 min). January resolution season is coming.

evidence.signal: Keeping weight off during and after GLP-1 treatment (25 Nov)
Weight regain follows incretin cessation (26 Nov)

candidates.angle: A device how-to. The existing Pen video (qiLPt1hHGL0) needs the retitle 'Mounjaro Pen: How to Use It, Step by Step', not a new video. New Shorts stay on visible pen moments: a bead of blood, a bruise, a click with no feeling. Each links to the Pen how-to.

candidates.topic: GLP-1 pill or tirzepatide shot? Foundayo, the Wegovy pill and Mounjaro/Zepbound compared, label by label (approved drugs only)
candidates.angle: A head-to-head against tirzepatide using each drug's own label and pivotal trial. Clearly say these are separate trials, not a direct comparison. Cover the daily pill vs weekly shot routine, food and water rules from each label, and common side effects. No dosing and no cost talk. Check the live list first so it doesn't repeat Foundayo What to Expect or Zepbound vs Wegovy.
keywords: is the weight loss pill as good as mounjaro
candidates.why_now: The Foundayo launch is spreading (TGA registration, Canada, UK). Lilly's Medicare Part D Foundayo and Zepbound explainer ran on 23 Nov. GoodRx's '14 new weight loss drugs' ran on 24 Nov. Head-to-heads are a proven outlier format.

14 new weight loss drugs (24 Nov)

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide nausea: why it happens, when it usually eases (mostly around dose increases), and foods that may help
candidates.angle: Felt-symptom Shorts and chapters. The mechanism is slowed stomach emptying. The timeline: it usually eases over time. Gentle food steps: bland foods, smaller meals, stop at full. Use the ABC Australia 'side effects, we ask the experts' piece and HCPLive's GI-symptom report as fresh hooks. For Foundayo nausea Shorts, link to ssb7Zcs3KSY.
keywords: what to eat for nausea on mounjaro
candidates.why_now: Fresh mainstream pickup on side effects: ABC Australia (25 Nov), HCPLive (25 Nov) and Pharmacy Times (25 Nov). Our Foundayo nausea Short had 845 views.

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide injection site reactions: redness, itching, small lumps. Is this normal? (label 6–8% by dose vs about 2% on placebo)
candidates.angle: A calm 'Is this normal?' body moment with the relief fact first. Cover rotation per the Instructions for Use and when to call (spreading redness, warmth, pus). Link to the Pen how-to. The 11-09 backup long video must be re-timed before it ships.

candidates.topic: 'Nature's Ozempic' oats and fibre: what beta-glucan and fibre actually do to your own GLP-1, and why it isn't the same as the medicine
candidates.angle: The natural-support pillar, myth-busting in a positive tone. Fibre and protein can nudge your own gut GLP-1 and fullness. The effect is real but far smaller than the drugs, which act at much higher, sustained levels. Practical eating-order and fibre tips for people on tirzepatide (with constipation and hydration in mind). Titles that sit naturally next to the big 'Ozempic' videos.

candidates.angle: A life-on-GLP-1 habit chapter with 'linked to' wording only. Sleep is one lever we control alongside protein and lifting. Pair it with the approved tirzepatide sleep apnea use for the broad 'GLP-1 and sleep' search.

candidates.topic: Eating enough on tirzepatide: protein and nutrients when appetite is low
candidates.angle: Practical and encouraging. Low appetite is the medicine working. The protein-first plate, easy high-protein foods and strength training to protect muscle (75/25 from the DXA substudy only). Fold it into a broad Lane A video or chapters, not a narrow long video.
candidates.why_now: It has appeared in 5 snapshots in a row. Grocery Dive and FoodNavigator report GLP-1 households shifting to fresh foods.

evidence.signal: GLP-1s shift household spending toward fresh products (25 Nov)

candidates.topic: Semaglutide in older and frailer adults: the SELECT frailty analysis (heart benefit consistent across frailty levels)
candidates.angle: Benefits beyond weight for a 60-plus audience. SELECT population only: preexisting cardiovascular disease and BMI 27 or more, without diabetes. Heart benefit didn't differ by frailty, and quality-of-life gains looked larger in frailer people. Pair it with a muscle-protection message. Best as a chapter in a heart-benefits video.
candidates.why_now: Medical Dialogues re-covered it on 26 Nov. A JAPAN SELECT subanalysis (Circ J, 21 Nov) and the SOUL oral semaglutide repeat-event analysis (AJMC, 23 Nov) add depth.

evidence.signal: Wegovy benefits in the SELECT population consistent regardless of frailty level
